entries.name: Other notable taxes (trading licence tax (districts))
entries.statute: Law n° 75/2018 of 07/09/2018 determining the sources of revenue and property of decentralised entities (immovable property tax, rental income tax, trading licence tax)
entries.why: triage minor: trading licence tax (districts): local business licence. listed by the registry (background (unverified)); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Withholding tax on dividends (15 %)
entries.statute: Law n° 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 on income tax, art. 60 1° (not amended by laws 051/2023 and 014/2025)
entries.doc: art. 60: a withholding tax of 15 % of the total amount is levied on payments by resident persons, including dividends (1°) and financial interests (2°).
unsupported: finality for individuals not stated in law 027/2022 (treated as the final tax on the payment)
dividends under art. 47 (2) and collective investment distributions

entries.name: Withholding tax on interest (15 %)
entries.statute: Law n° 027/2022 art. 60 2° [text version: Law n° 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 as published, not amended on this point by Laws 051/2023 and 014/2025]
unsupported: interest on deposits of at least one year is exempt (art. 60 2° a): not distinguished

entries.name: Mandatory pension scheme, employer share (6 % = half of 12 %)
entries.statute: Prime Minister's Order n° 086/2024 art. 1 (a) (12 % from 1 January 2025; repeals PMO 009/2016) and Law n° 05/2015 art. 8 (employer and employee contribute equally) [text version: Prime Minister's Order n° 086/2024 as published (12 % from 1 January 2025); Law n° 05/2015 as published]
entries.doc: PMO 086/2024 art. 1: contribution rate 12 % of the remuneration subject to contribution from 1 January 2025 (14 % from 2027, rising to 20 % in 2030); Law 05/2015 art. 8: shared equally between employer and employee.
unsupported: occupational hazards and maternity leave contributions (not modelled)

entries.name: Maternity leave benefits scheme, employer share (0,3 % of gross salary)
entries.statute: Law n° 003/2016 establishing and governing maternity leave benefits scheme (Official Gazette n° Special of 20/04/2016) art. 6-7; Law n° 049/2024 of 04/06/2024 amends registration, audit, benefit calculation, payment and reimbursement, not the rate of art. 7 [text version: Law n° 003/2016 as published (Official Gazette n° Special of 20/04/2016), with Law n° 049/2024 of 04/06/2024]
entries.doc: art. 6: contributions are based on the gross salary; art. 7: the contribution is 0,6 % of the salary, the employer and the employee each paying 0,3 %.

entries.name: Occupational hazards scheme, employer contribution (2 % of salary)
entries.statute: RSSB page 'Occupational Hazards' (Wayback 2013-07-09, R4/fetch/p14/rw_rssb_oh_2013.html): 'A contribution of 2% of salary is paid on behalf of mandatory members by employers'; Law n° 06/2003 of 22/03/2003 (RSSB copy, damaged: art. 1-5 OCR'd, the rate articles lost) not usable; edition 2013 flagged
entries.doc: Employer only, no employee share, no ceiling stated. Fourteenth pass (FT reviewer 4 gap).
unsupported: official page of 2013 (older than 2025; no later instrument located that changes the rate)
